title: eludite.git.merge input
description: Merge a branch into the current one (the Git Repository window's Merge into current branch): a fast-forward when possible (unless `no_ff`), else a merge commit with the identity rule of eludite.git.commit. On a conflict it stops with the conflicted paths: their files have conflict markers and open in the editor; stage each resolved file, then eludite.git.commit finishes the merge; `abort` returns to HEAD (losing the resolution so far). The repository is the one discovered from the open workspace (solution folder or opened folder) upward, as `git` discovers it; without one the command fails naming eludite.git.init.
x-eludite-escalates: With `abort`: dangerous for an agent when the solution's policy sets `git.history` to `prompt` (the default), refused when `deny`.

no_ff.description: Always create a merge commit. Default false.

message.description: The merge commit's message. Default `Merge branch '<branch>'`.

abort.description: Abort the merge in progress instead (history class for agents).
